    Stop 1 of 8Your adventure starts here

    Pink Passage

    A pink gateway of light, mirrors and art, where the outside world fades and the PinkOut experience begins. Every visit starts and ends here.

    What your brand can do

    • Brand the entrance
    • Create a signature art installation
    • Build a photo moment around your brand

    The value for your brand

    • Make your brand her first discovery
    • A photo setting featuring your identity
    • Visibility at arrival and departure
  3. 02
    Stop 2 of 8Meet in the middle

    Rose Hub

    The social heart of PinkOut: friends meet here, grab a favourite drink and take a break before exploring the next world.

    What your brand can do

    • Take over the activation space
    • Create a signature drink
    • Café collaboration: cups, menu, sampling

    The value for your brand

    • Introduce your product during a café break
    • Space for relaxed customer conversations
    • Sampling linked to a shared social moment
  4. 03
    Stop 3 of 8Make it yours

    Make Studio

    A small idea becomes something to take home: visitors pick their materials, add a personal touch and make it themselves.

    What your brand can do

    • Branded make-and-take
    • Sponsor a workshop station
    • Personalise your product: engrave, embroider

    The value for your brand

    • Time spent creating with your product
    • A branded keepsake to take home
    • A chance to hear what customers like
  5. 04
    Stop 4 of 8Find your next favourite

    Pink Market

    A colourful collection of small shops and pop-ups to wander through: a new brand to discover, a gift to choose, something sweet.

    What your brand can do

    • Launch a pop-up store
    • A limited-edition drop
    • Sponsor the zone

    The value for your brand

    • A physical space to showcase and sell
    • Direct conversations before purchase
    • A setting to introduce your next launch
  6. 05
    Stop 5 of 8Feel the energy

    PinkOut Live

    Where everyone comes together for a shared moment: a performance, a creator to discover, the buzz around the stage.

    What your brand can do

    • Launch on stage
    • Host talks and podcasts
    • Sponsor performances and DJ sets

    The value for your brand

    • A stage for your product story
    • A live demonstration for the audience
    • Branded moments to discuss capturing

    Beauty Lab

    Beauty through hands-on experiences: visitors play with shades, discover scents and experiment with their own look.

    What your brand can do

    • Product trials
    • Personalisation experiences
    • Brand boutique and launches

    • Product trial before a purchase decision
    • Conversations about shades, scents and fit
    • A setting to demonstrate your difference
  8. 07

    What your brand can do

    • Wellness sessions

    The value for your brand

    • Sampling when your product fits the moment

    • Own the last photo moment
    • A thank-you in your name at the door

    The value for your brand

    • A final reminder of your brand
    • A take-home sample to keep discovering
    • An offer that gives her a reason to return

Your investment

What does your brand get?

Start with what you want customers to do: discover your brand, try your product or buy from you. Then choose the presence and experience that support that goal. These partnership options are a starting point for your proposal.

Sponsorship

Biggest presence

Season partner

Build familiarity across the visitor journey, with your brand present throughout the season.

  • VisibilityBrand presence across all seven zones
  • ExperienceA launch moment on PinkOut Live
  • ContentOn-site content capture, with scope to agree
  • RecapA review of the agreed season activity

Zone partner

Connect your product to an experience where visitors can see why it matters.

  • VisibilityYour name on one zone
  • ExperienceTrials or a branded activity in it
  • ContentZone content, with formats and usage to agree
See it in the tour

Stage partner

Give your launch a live audience and room to show what makes your product different.

  • VisibilityStage naming
  • ExperienceLaunch, talk or performance slots
  • ContentStage content, with capture and usage to agree
See it in the tour

Themed-day partner

Focus your campaign on one themed day, with your brand part of the experience.

  • VisibilityVenue-wide, on the day
  • ExperienceActivation woven into the theme
  • ContentBranded photo and content opportunities

These options are indicative. Request the event partner deck to discuss pricing, availability and the exact inclusions for your brand. Final scope and terms are agreed in your proposal.

Know what your investment covers.

Agree these in your proposal before you commit:

  • Placements: where your brand appears
  • Activation space and timing
  • Who produces what
  • Content rights and usage
  • How success is measured: samples, sign-ups or sales

How it works

  1. Share your goalTell us what success looks like for your brand
  2. Explore the fitDiscuss the deck, options and budget
  3. Agree the scopeDefine deliverables, roles and measures together
  4. Bring it to lifeDeliver the agreed experience at PinkOut
FAQ

Good questions, clear answers.

What exactly is PinkOut?

A women-first lifestyle, creativity and entertainment destination coming soon to Riyadh, with seven experience zones and an app in development.

When and where does it open?

In Riyadh. The exact date and venue will be announced once confirmed.

What are the fees or commission?

Commercial terms are shared after you apply, in the deck for your partner type.

Are any partners confirmed?

No partnerships have been announced yet.

Can we choose a zone or a themed day?

Yes. Pick them in the enquiry form, or open the form from any zone, package or theme and it's filled in for you.

How do we get the event partner deck?

Tick "Send me the deck" in the enquiry form. It's on by default.
